title: Hiking Safety Bundle Printable, Safety Guide + Emergency Checklist + If You Get Lost Pocket Card PDF, Trail Safety Gift for Hikers
description:
The three HikeSupply safety guides together, for hikers who want to be ready for the day that does not go to plan. $16.99 instead of $20.97 bought separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Hiking Safety Guide: ten chapters on what actually goes wrong (late starts, weather turning, cold and heat, injuries, running out of daylight, wildlife, calling for help) plus a one-page emergency reference
- Hiking Emergency Checklist: the kit to build once, the two-minute pre-trip check, step-by-step pages for getting lost, injuries and bad weather, and an information card
- What To Do If You Get Lost: the first ten minutes, retrace or stay, being findable, an unplanned night out, and a fold-up pocket card

WHAT YOU GET
- Each guide in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition, one ZIP per format
- Instant download. These are digital files; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
General information for recreational hikers. Not a substitute for first-aid or navigation training, local knowledge, or emergency services. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
sub: Safety guide, emergency checklist and the lost-hiker method with a pocket card.
